data.name: Marni
data.gender_notes: Marni is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek Maraina, meaning ‘resembling the sea’ or ‘god’s light’. In the New Testament, Marana (or Maranatha) is a term used by early Christians to express their longing for the return of Christ. The name Marni carries the meaning “God's light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marni usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine light guiding us through life.
data.etymology: Marni belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marni total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
